**Core Innovation:** The framework introduces a user-centric approach for Explainability Assessment by leveraging GPT-generated personas to evaluate the interpretability of AI systems.

**Technical Approach:** 
- Utilizes GPT to generate personas that mimic diverse user interactions.
- Employs quantitative metrics to assess model interpretability.
- Integrates with existing AI frameworks for seamless implementation.

**Quantitative Findings:**  
1. Improved interpretability scores by 15% when personas are included.
2. Enhanced user satisfaction by 20% through more relatable explanations.
3. Achieved 90% accuracy in identifying key features by the AI model.

**Limitations & Assumptions:**  
- Assumes availability of sufficient labeled data for GPT training.  
- Relies on the effectiveness of GPT in generating accurate personas.  
- Limited testing on real-world scenarios may affect generalizability.

**Domain Impact:**  
- The framework enhances theoretical understanding of AI explainability.  
- Practically aids developers in improving user interaction and satisfaction.
